Type: lift-top storage coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and remotes, working from the sofa; living room
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: wood veneer top and box, black powder-coated metal frame
Colors: dark espresso brown, black
Shape: rectangular, deep apron box with hidden storage under a lift top, thin square metal legs, open lower shelf, medium visual weight
Feel: practical, sleek, grounded
Goes with: dark wood, black metal, grey or leather sofas; industrial or modern living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Heights Wood Lift Top Storage Coffee Table, 43.3"W, Espresso
product.description: Plywood with espresso walnut laminate and matte black-finished metal legs and hardware Top lifts up to reveal inside storage; shelf on bottom adds extra display space Wood/metal combo and straight lines blend with modern or industrial décor 15-30 minutes assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. 23.6"L x 43.3"W x 15.7"H
